visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair featuring vibrant green streaks is seen in a medium close-up shot. She is wearing a white collared shirt with a black necktie. Against a neutral green-grey wall, she holds a large silver hairdryer, blowing a high-velocity stream of air directly at her face, causing her hair to fly wildly in all directions. (2) The camera transitions to a closer view of her face as she points to her bangs with her right index finger. She has shimmering eye makeup and pink lip color. A cream-colored vintage audio speaker is visible in the background to her left. She smiles broadly while demonstrating the product. (3) A screen-split montage appears showing her face in three different lighting conditions, labeled with digital clock icons representing morning, afternoon, and evening. Her green-tinted bangs remain perfectly flat and styled against her forehead in each frame despite the implied passage of time. (4) The woman is shown applying a clear liquid from a small pink-capped bottle onto her forehead using a brush applicator. She carefully positions her hair over the treated areas and presses down with her fingers to secure the strands. Her expression is focused as she performs this meticulous task. (5) In the final phase, she repeats the hairdryer test, blowing air directly onto her styled bangs. The hair does not move at all. She reacts with an exaggerated expression of shock, opening her mouth wide and eyes bulging in a comedic, excited manner while holding the silver dryer.
